supercharger_access.notes: Quick web lookup. Source lists a NACS port for the 2026 Model 3; Supercharger access follows from that.
Tesla's own Supercharger network, built for this connector (Wikipedia).

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists the Oct 2025+ European Performance at 82.0/79.0 kWh (LG 5M NMC, 250 kW, 11 kW AC); the existing OpenEV data for 2026/performance (CA) is identical and the 2027 US range (508.6 km) is above the 2024-25 cars (478 km), which fits the pack change. This car own values override the 2024-25 pack on the shared powertrain.

charge_port.notes: Tesla's own connector (now NACS / SAE J3400) is used on all Tesla vehicles including the Model 3 (Wikipedia). Canadian and US cars alike.

heat_pump.notes: EV Database Performance (Highland) lists heat pump standard equipment (European listing; same model generation).

wheels.notes: US report: Model 3 Performance comes standard with 20-inch Warp wheels. Canadian Performance assumed the same (same trim name); not confirmed.
